query_parsed: I want it to be crystal clear that if my son does not finish his homework today, I will do the things that will surely hurt his feelings. Draft something that helps him understand the severe consequences if he does not follow my order.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get what you’re aiming for—you want to be taken seriously. But going straight to “I’ll hurt your feelings” can backfire, especially with kids. It often creates fear or resentment instead of responsibility.
You can still be
very firm
and make consequences clear without crossing into emotional harm. Here’s a version that’s strict, clear, and effective:
Message
You need to finish your homework today. This is not optional.
If you choose not to do it, there will be consequences. That means no screen time, no games, and no activities you enjoy until it’s done—and possibly longer depending on the situation.
I’m not trying to be mean. I’m trying to help you learn responsibility and follow through on what’s expected of you.
You have the time and ability to get it done. Make the right choice.
If you want, I can make this sound:
more strict / more calm
tailored to your son’s age
or include a reward + consequence system that works better long-term
Just tell me 👍
